rule0.statement: The S2 macaque table is transcribable by double-entry vision (two independent full passes, different segmentation order + different read strategy, no cross-consultation) with law-verified admission at or above the pre-registered stop floors: double-entry exact-agreement >= 80% on legible cells AND closure-law pass >= 90% on checkable rows.
prediction: P-AGREE: exact-agreement 85-95% on cells whose legibility class is CLEAR in both passes (per-cell digit identity, format-normalized)

P-LAW: the pcsa_closure law catches most DISPUTED cells -- a single misread digit in mass/FL/PCSA breaks |PCSA - 943.3962*mass/FL|/PCSA_pred by >= ~10%, far above the 2% inherited tolerance, so disputed cells either resolve against the law or stay refused

P-UNREADABLE: 10-20% of the 1512-cell table is genuinely unreadable at this scan quality (the intake's best faithful tier reached only 4.8% CONFIDENT) -- those cells stay REFUSED, named; the honest result may be 'this scan needs better imaging', never guessed numbers

P-MARKERS: the source itself carries text markers inside value cells ('absent (cf. EDST)', 'damaged', 'not measured' -- measured by the intake's calibration row1 reads) -- these transcribe as named refusals marker_absent / marker_damaged / marker_not_measured, never numbers, in both passes

P-CLOSURE: for rows where all three fields are truly printed and transcribed TENTATIVE, the closure deviation distribution is rounding-driven and tight (median < 1%); a bimodal or fat-tailed distribution above the 2% band is reported as the finding, not tuned around
falsifier: F1 STOP-FLOOR: either stop floor missed (agreement < 0.80 on legible cells, or closure-law pass < 0.90 on checkable rows) -- STOP, report the measured rates; admission does not proceed
F2 NO-GUESS: any admitted cell lacking BOTH-pass exact agreement AND a law verdict -- fired; the cell is demoted to REFUSED and the receipt counts it

F3 PROVENANCE: every admitted value carries crop sha256 + panel identity + row/col identity (muscle x specimen x field) + both pass values + legibility classes + law verdict -- any admitted record missing any of these fires F3

F4 DETERMINISM: the reconciliation + law scripts are 3-run byte-identical on frozen inputs (the transcription itself is two human-class reads -- the LAWS and the scripts are the determinism); crop pinning script 3-run byte-identical (same bytes -> same shas + geometry)

F5 LANE SCOPE: any source change outside tools/science_funnel/validation/vanhoof_transcription_20260920/ (lane dir) + the out-of-repo staging dir E:/ChimeraWork/vanhoof2-staging/ (derived PNG tiles; never committed) -- fired; committed artifacts are transcriptions + receipts + scripts ONLY; no image bytes enter git from this lane
honest_classes: TENTATIVE: pass A == pass B exactly (format-normalized numeric equality)
DISPUTED: A != B, or legible in only one pass
MARKED-ABSENT: source text marker transcribed as named refusal (marker_absent / marker_damaged / marker_not_measured / unread_marker)
UNREADABLE: at least one pass records legibility UNREADABLE and the other does not CLEARLY contradict -- refused unreadable_cell
ADMITTED: TENTATIVE + law verdict pass (pcsa_closure for its row where checkable; ratio/register signals recorded) -- carries F3 provenance
REFUSED: everything else, with a named code from the closed taxonomy

laws_predeclared_constants_inherited_not.rho_source: adapters_muscle.py MUSCLE_DENSITY_KG_M3 and admit_vanhoof.py RHO_KG_M3 -- the funnel's existing constant, inherited verbatim
laws_predeclared_constants_inherited_not.tolerance_source: adapters_muscle.py LAW_TOLERANCE / admit_vanhoof.py LAW_TOLERANCE -- inherited verbatim; NOT re-derived, NOT swept
laws_predeclared_constants_inherited_not.pcsa_closure: PCSA_mm2_pred = 1e6 * (mass_g/1000) / (1060.0 * fl_mm/1000) = 943.3962 * mass_g / fl_mm; check |PCSA_table - PCSA_pred|/PCSA_pred <= 0.02

runnable_row_laws.pcsa_closure_dev: checkable iff mass_g, fl_mm, pcsa_mm2 all transcribed numeric for that (muscle, specimen); joint verdict for the row-triple
runnable_row_laws.mass_additivity_dev: NOT RUNNABLE on this manifest (no belly/tendon mass columns in S2) -- named not-runnable per the intake successor scope
runnable_row_laws.density_law: NOT RUNNABLE (no volume column) -- named not-runnable
runnable_row_laws.mtu_additivity: NOT RUNNABLE (no MTU/tendon columns) -- named not-runnable

auxiliary_signals_reported_never_sole_ad.cross_animal_share_ratio: per (field, specimen): value / specimen-column-total per muscle; a muscle's share of an animal's total should be broadly consistent across the 7 animals (same species); flag if share deviates > 50% relative from the cross-animal median share -- recorded as ratio_flag, never an admitter, a refusal-coefficient only when closure cannot run
auxiliary_signals_reported_never_sole_ad.decimal_register: per numeric column: decimal-place register mode coverage >= 0.80 else the column's register law suspends and is reported (the intake's F-REGISTER, inherited at the intake's own cut)

stop_floors.behavior_if_missed: STOP with measured rates; zero admission; the finding is the finding (F1)

admission_bookkeeping.count_identity: 1512 = admitted + refused(weighted by named code), zero silent drops, per the funnel's own discipline; every one of the 1512 grid positions is classified
admission_bookkeeping.merged_cells_note: the intake measured merged cells (FDP rows, conn. FDS-FDP) -- a merged/b_shared cell is transcribed at its anchor position and refused merged_cell at the covered positions, never duplicated

work_plan: 1. prep: convert S2 TIFF -> RGB PNG (PIL; CMYK->RGB; fixed constants, no sweeps), detect ruling lines, tile into overlapping named panels (the intake declares two; subdivide if glyph density demands -- subdivision decided by measured glyph px height vs tile px size, not taste), pin every crop (sha256 + geometry) in crops_manifest.json; 3-run byte-identical

2. pass A: read every panel, panel-order FORWARD, read strategy ROW-WISE (muscle-major: full row left-to-right, muscle name first); per cell: value + legibility class (CLEAR/DEGRADED/UNREADABLE/MARKED-ABSENT+marker text); written COMPLETELY to transcription_passA.json + .csv before pass B starts

3. pass B: read every panel, panel-order REVERSE, read strategy COLUMN-WISE (animal-major: full specimen-column block top-to-bottom, field-major within it); produced WITHOUT consulting pass A (pass A file closed and sha-pinned first); written COMPLETELY to transcription_passB.json + .csv
4. reconcile.py: A==B -> TENTATIVE; else DISPUTED; markers -> named refusals; agreement rates measured vs the F1 floor
5. laws.py: pcsa_closure per checkable (muscle, specimen) row-triple; ratio + register signals recorded; law pass rate vs the F1 floor; admission tiers with F3 provenance per admitted cell
6. receipt per-falsifier + record.md ledger append + tests if applicable + commit 'Agent: vtrans' + push lane branch
determinism_plan: reconcile.py and laws.py read ONLY frozen JSON inputs and write canonical JSON (sort_keys, fixed floats); 3 consecutive runs must be byte-identical (sha256 compared); the prep pinning likewise. The two transcription passes are human-class reads and are NOT claimed deterministic -- F4 binds the scripts and the pins.
no_tuning_clause: no constant in this lane is chosen to lift an agreement or pass rate; 0.80/0.90 floors, 0.02 tolerance, 1060 rho, 943.3962 factor, the 50% ratio flag and the 0.80 register cut are inherited or pre-named before any reading; if a law under-performs, the rate is REPORTED, the constant is not moved
